imageSlots: HIFI-29-01 — Meal Detail / Food Logger instructional media thumbnails, Balencia warm-dark glass UI asset, privacy-safe, no brand logos, no readable UI text.
trustControls: Meal, ingredient, scanner, and database ChipProvenance chips ('you logged', 'food database', 'verified', 'portion estimated') open nutrition-source controls: freshness, confidence, retention, export, revoke imported source, delete meal/media entries.
Allergy and dietary-restriction chips are visible beside the source/provenance row in BOTH Meal Detail and Food Logging modes, not logging-only.
Scanner (barcode/receipt) results render as suggestions only until the user confirms each item; nothing auto-commits.
Media is consent-gated: no identifiable face, body, home, document, or provider logo, and no private text, appears without explicit permission.
Honest-null and low-confidence states use exact copy ('Log this meal to see its split.', 'portion estimated', 'estimated · low confidence') — never a fabricated calorie or macro value.
CIA copy is coaching support only, never medical nutrition advice.
notes: Mode transition: content below the stable TopBar crossfades over 520ms between Meal Detail and Food Logging modes. Macro percentages are calculated as protein×4, carbs×4, fat×9 before rendering, never invented. Reduced motion: donut arcs and bars render instantly (no sweep), the mode crossfade becomes opacity-only, and count-ups are skipped.
